crossRefs.note: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek Yahweh shall not lack any good thing.
“Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,
For Yahweh says to me, “As the lion and the young lion growling over his prey, if a multitude of shepherds is called…
and say, ‘What was your mother? A lioness. She couched among lions, in the middle of the young lions she nourished her…
Will a lion roar in the thicket, when he has no prey? Does a young lion cry out of his den, if he has caught nothing?
He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.
Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?
How the animals groan! The herds of livestock are perplexed, because they have no pasture. Yes, the flocks of sheep are…
Yes, the animals of the field pant to you, for the water brooks have dried up, And the fire has devoured the pastures…
Don’t be afraid, you animals of the field; for the pastures of the wilderness spring up, for the tree bears its fruit.…

translations.web: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.
translations.bsb: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
translations.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
translations.asv: The young lions roar after their prey, And seek their food from God.
